CustomField.label: Omnishift Disposition
CustomField.description: What the advisor did with the draft. This metadata previously declared a restricted picklist while the org has always held Text(80); Salesforce cannot convert Text to Picklist, so every deploy of this file failed and the restriction never existed. A value outside the intended set had already been written and had to be corrected by hand. The restricted training label is Omnishift_Outcome__c, which was created as a picklist from the start.
